Directions for Use:

  1. With the bottle upright, prime the trigger several times.
  2. Spray evenly over entire surface area, holding the bottle 6-8 inches from the shoe to avoid oversaturation. Note: the bottle will spray a consistent, even mist when used properly.
  3. Allow shoes to dry completely before exposure to outdoor elements.

products.title: Shoe Care Kit
products.body_html:
Want to keep your TravisMathew shoes looking and feeling fresh long after the first wear? Of course you do! Give your new favorite footwear some TLC with our travel-friendly SHOE CARE KIT, complete with all the tools you’ll need to maintain a clean appearance, protect your shoes from the elements, and extend their lifespan for endless steps.

Includes 2oz foam cleaner, 2oz foam protector, 2oz refresher, handle brush, and towel. These formulas have been carefully created for use on all TravisMathew footwear products, regardless of material. Our foam protector is PFOA free.

Directions for Use:

  1. Using the handle brush, gently remove all dirt and debris from shoes.
  2. Apply foam cleaner directly to the handle brush. Scrub shoes using soft, careful strokes. Wipe clean with towel and allow to air dry.
  3. Spray foam protector evenly over entire surface area, holding the bottle 6-8 inches from the shoe to avoid oversaturation. Note: the bottle will spray a consistent, even mist when trigger is primed and used properly. Allow shoes to dry completely before exposure to outdoor elements.
  4. Spray refresher directly into shoe interior. Allow to dry completely before wearing.
  5. Want a next-level clean your feet will thank you for? Remove your insoles and give them a quick scrub using the foam cleaner and handle brush. Allow insoles to air dry completely before returning them to your shoes.
